title: My New Flat
text:
I have a new flat. It is small but nice. There is a bathroom and a bedroom. The flat has a balcony with two chairs.

The living room has a large table in the middle. There is also a wardrobe for my clothes. My cat likes to sleep on the sofa. I love my new home.

questions.text: How many chairs are on the balcony?
What is in the living room for the writer's clothes?
How does the writer probably feel about the flat?
Why is the cat probably comfortable in the flat?
options: It has a soft sofa to sleep on
It has a very loud room

vocabulary.definition: a small outdoor platform attached to the wall of a building
a tall cupboard where clothes are kept
a room with a bath or shower and a toilet
a long, soft seat for two or more people

paragraph_translations: Mam nowe mieszkanie. Jest małe, ale ładne. Jest tam łazienka i sypialnia. Mieszkanie ma balkon z dwoma krzesłami.
W salonie na środku stoi duży stół. Jest tam też szafa na moje ubrania. Mój kot lubi spać na kanapie. Kocham mój nowy dom.
